entries.value: "`bsc lan` domain vocabulary and adapter traits for the LAN control plane. Pure types and traits; no I/O. Folded from the networkmonitor repo's bsc-lan-core (2026-09-04) when the stack collapsed onto suricata + one native process."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# This crate performs no I/O. It must never depend on an async runtime, an
# HTTP client, an SSH library, an embedded database or the app shell -- see
# tests/dependency_absence.rs, which pins that guarantee against this crate's
# OWN resolved dependency closure (not merely the workspace lockfile, which in
# a monorepo necessarily contains all of them for its other members).

lead: # Adding an `Action` variant must fail to compile until every exhaustive
# dispatch (tier, target, render, inverse_kind, requires_ttl) grows an arm.
# A `_ =>` wildcard arm would silently defeat that guarantee, so it is denied
# crate-wide rather than merely discouraged.
# THIS DECLARATION IS ITSELF GUARDED. Deleting these two lines is the one edit
# that would dissolve the exhaustiveness guarantee without breaking a single
# test, so tests/dependency_absence.rs asserts the declaration is still here.
# ...and its blind spot, MEASURED 2026-09-04 during the fold. `wildcard_enum_match_arm`
# only fires when the wildcard covers TWO OR MORE remaining variants. Adding exactly one
# catalog action and silencing the resulting E0004 with `_ =>` -- by far the likeliest way
# this guarantee actually gets defeated -- passed clippy completely with only the lint
# above. `match_wildcard_for_single_variants` is the one that catches that case ("wildcard
# matches only a single variant and will also match any future added variants"); it lives
# in the pedantic group, so it is off unless named here. The pair is the guarantee; either
# alone has a hole. tests/dependency_absence.rs asserts BOTH are still declared.
